manifest.tape_rule: Step k uses the k-th RandomTape.draw(numpy.random.default_rng(seed)), exactly as run_round draws advertiser-round tapes, independent of bids.

span_hold.description: After a contest, the winner owns the word, number or capitalised name its token starts and proposes each next token from its own distribution; a proposal that continues the span is emitted without contest or charge, any other proposal releases the span and the step runs the reference auction.

manifest.interval_rule: A wins a contested step iff u < lambda. At interval (lo, hi]: u <= lo gives A, u >= hi gives B, otherwise (lo, u] takes B and (u, hi] takes A.
